_about: Names a record carries that are not the man's own, removed by hand. Keyed by an entry the record holds (book:index), so the key survives merges and renumbering of person ids. Each needs the entry's own words showing whose name it is.

names.name: ضمرة بن أبي ضمرة
names.why: The record is the grandfather of al-Ḥusayn b. Ḍamra («عن الحسين بن ضمرة، عن أبيه، عن جده»), i.e. Abū Ḍamra; «ضمرة بن أبي ضمرة» is his son, al-Ḥusayn's father.

names.name: ابن علي بن زياد الوشّاء
names.why: A fragment of «هو ابن زياد الوشاء المتقدم» (al-Ardabīlī) read as a name; al-Khoei adds that the identification «لم يثبت».

names.name: ابن علي بن زياد الوشّاء
names.why: The same fragment, from al-Ardabīlī's line «هو ابن زياد - الوشاء المتقدم».
